name: MeterTrack
description: Represents the full range of the meter and renders `Meter.IndicatorPrimitive` inside. Renders a `<div>` element.

props.name: aria-valuetext
props.description: Defines the human readable text alternative of aria-valuenow for a range widget.

props.name: className
props.description: CSS class applied to the element, or a function that returns a class based on the component’s state.

props.name: indicatorElement
props.description: A Custom element for Meter.IndicatorPrimitive. If not provided, the default Meter.IndicatorPrimitive will be rendered.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the element, or a function that returns a style object based on the component’s state.

props.name: render
props.description:
Allows you to replace the component’s HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.
Accepts a ReactElement or a function that returns the element to render.
